title: fix(plugin-charts): an object-chart whose specType is a single-value or tabular family draws its routed form, not a silent bar; no default family (objectui#11520)
body:
Fixes #11520

Clause-②: yes (widening). The faces' accept sets do not move (both accept these documents before and after). One exported type widens: `NormalizedChartSchema['chartType']` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`) goes from the thirteen drawn families to the declared chart families, `DeclaredChartFamily`: the `object-chart` node's own `chartType` union (objectui#11513) together with its `specType` (the spec's `ChartType`), both read off `ObjectChartSchema` in `@object-ui/types` by reference, never restated. It now carries the family the schema names, drawn or not, and a misspelled family still fails to compile. The claim's `no` assumed no exported type would move; this is the flip it provided for.

Dispatched by the PM loop, round 1 (`domain:ui` seat 1), claim comment `5963741843`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`. Triage ruling `5963338583` executed as written.

## The defect, reproduced at BASE `8366accd1`

An `object-chart` whose family is on `specType` (the react tier's key: the react-page wrapper parks the `ObjectChart` block's `type="gauge"` there) with `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `metric`, `kpi`, `bullet`, `table` or `pivot` parses on both faces and draws a **bar chart** with no note. The new pin's BASE run, through the real `SchemaRenderer`, read every such cell as one bar mark on one value axis, categories across, no notice. The off-spec `sunburst` on `specType` drew a bar too.

Mechanism, measured as the card read it:

1. `normalizeChartSchema` read `specType`, then kept the family only when `RENDERABLE` held it.
2. `ChartRenderer`'s `schema.chartType ?? spec.chartType` was then unset.
3. `AdvancedChartImpl` defaulted an unset family to `'bar'`. Its four refusal guards each restated that default (`props.chartType ?? 'bar'`).

## The fix

- **Which dispatcher.** The one family to form decision this block makes is `AdvancedChartImpl`'s family dispatch, keyed on `SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES` / `TABULAR_CHART_TYPES` / `RENDERABLE` in `normalizeChartSchema.ts`. It is the branch the `chartType` channel already reaches, and it draws exactly the forms the ruling names: the number card and the tabular notice. `widgetDispatch` lives in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src`. It routes dashboard widgets to dashboard node types (a metric-card node, a records table, a pivot) and has no tabular notice. plugin-dashboard depends on plugin-charts (as a dev dependency), and plugin-charts could not import it without a reverse dependency. So there is no fork: `specType` is routed through plugin-charts' own dispatch, with no new family list and no edit to either table.
- **`normalizeChartSchema`** hands the named family on as named (`chartType`, else `specType`, else a bare `type` that is a spec family, else a registered keyword's family). It no longer filters by `RENDERABLE`. `specType` now reaches the dispatch with the same value `chartType` does.
- **`AdvancedChartImpl`**: the `= 'bar'` default is removed. The four guard copies go with it, through one `guardFamily` helper that reads `column` as `bar` and nothing as nothing. An absent family is the existing unknown-type notice (`data-testid="advanced-chart-unknown-type"`, `role="note"`, the same element and the "nothing was drawn" string family), reading "This chart names no chart type — nothing was drawn." An off-spec family keeps that notice's existing sentence, which names the value.
- `AdvancedChartImplProps['chartType']` (internal, not on the package entry) and `effectiveChartFamily`'s constraint take `DeclaredChartFamily` with it (patch round 1); no plain `string` remains on the family path. The cartesian root map moved below the dispatch, where the family is a drawn one. The emitted declarations of that last step are byte-identical.

**Callers that relied on the default (Zone 2 item 3).** Every source producer that reaches `AdvancedChartImpl` names its family explicitly:

- `DatasetPreview` passes `bar` / `combo`;
- `DatasetWidget` passes its map's family `?? 'bar'`;
- `DashboardRenderer` / `DashboardGridLayout` pass the series family `widgetDispatch` resolved;
- the list-view relays in `app-shell`, `plugin-list` and `plugin-view` pass `chartType || 'bar'`;
- the chatbot passes `chart.chartType ?? 'bar'`;
- the react-page wrapper passes `specType`.

No caller needed an edit. `ChartRenderer.tsx` is unchanged.

## Pins

`packages/plugin-charts/src/__tests__/object-chart-spectype-routing-11520.test.tsx` (new), through the real `SchemaRenderer` and this package's registrations:

- **The matrix, 21 families x 5 node shapes = 105 cells, each family on `specType`:** every family of the installed spec plus `sunburst`. The five shapes:
  1. the flat node with inline rows;
  2. the authored `properties` bag on the object path (the card's document);
  3. the dashboard producer's flat node;
  4. the react-page wrapper's own output (`{ ...props, specType, type }`);
  5. a dataset-bound node.

  Each cell is held to its routed form, read off the dispatch's sets: the number card, the tabular notice, the family's OWN marks for a drawn family (so a silent bar fails), or the unknown-type notice naming an off-spec value.
- **The bar control:** `bar`, `column` and `horizontal-bar` draw bars in every shape. A bare `chart` node naming `bar` draws a bar.
- **Unresolved family:** an `object-chart` naming no family (both faces refuse it) and a bare `chart` naming none show the notice, with zero bar marks.
- **The two channels agree:** per family, `specType` draws the form `chartType` draws (21 rows).
- **Premise:** the card's document parses on both faces for all 20 spec families on `specType`, and `sunburst` does not.
- **Re-judged:** `normalizeChartSchema.test.ts`'s "leaves a family this renderer cannot draw unset" pinned exactly the removed branch. It is replaced by "hands a family this renderer draws no chart of to the dispatch as named", over `metric`, `pivot`, `sunburst`, and `chartType` winning over `specType`.
- The objectui#11513 `chartType` refusals stay green: `object-chart-declared-families-11513.test.tsx`, `object-chart-families-11513.test.ts` and `object-chart-properties-bag-11276.test.ts`.

## Reverse verification and ablation (predicted first)

All at committed states. The subject resolves to `src` through the vitest alias, so no `dist` leg applies.

| leg | prediction | reading |
|---|---|---|
| **BASE** (the two source files at `8366accd1`, the final pin) | red on the 40 non-drawn cells (bars), the 8 non-drawn agreement rows and both no-family rows | **50 failed, 80 passed (130)**. Every red matrix cell read `marks:bar`. |
| **A1:** restore the normalizer's `RENDERABLE` gate (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `3c1f8ba7` to `df252daa`) | 48 red: 35 single-value / tabular cells, 5 `sunburst` cells, 7 agreement rows, 1 normalizer row | **48 failed, 126 passed (174)**, exactly those rows. Direction: red, and the substitute was now the "names no chart type" notice, not a bar, because the default is gone. |
| **A2:** restore `= 'bar'` alone (anchor 1 to 0, blob `b30ae64a` to `2e1a7193`) | exactly the 2 no-family rows | **2 failed, 172 passed (174)**, those two. |

Each restore was proven by blob equality with `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD` (the tool's own verdict, re-read by hand after each leg).

## Gates (round 0 at `a1e6721fa`; patch round 1 at `514d71d1f` below)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` plus the two `packages/types` 11513 / 11276 pins: **90 files, 1258 passed, 9 skipped**. The skips are the existing `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` block.
- Downstream, by `git grep -l`:
  - every test outside plugin-charts naming `object-chart`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `ChartRenderer`, `AdvancedChartImpl`, a `chart` node or `chart:bar`: **101 files, 3925 passed**. They span apps/console, examples/schema-catalog, app-shell, cli, components, core, data-objectstack, plugin-chatbot, plugin-dashboard, plugin-designer, plugin-list, plugin-report, plugin-view, react, runner, sdui-parser, types and scripts.
  - a second set naming `recharts` / `DatasetWidget` / `DashboardRenderer` / `DashboardGridLayout` not already in the first: **101 files, 1097 passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after its closure was built: exit 0. The rebuilt `normalizeChartSchema.d.ts` carried `chartType?: string` at `a1e6721fa`; after patch round 1 it carries `chartType?: DeclaredChartFamily`.
- The console, as `Bundle Analysis` runs it: `pnpm turbo run build --filter=./packages/*` (39 of 39), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` (`tsc`, vite build, SDUI manifest, `tsconfig.plugin.json`): exit 0 at `a1e6721fa`, and at `1954b64a1` before it.
- Exit 0 with their own verdict lines:
  - `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new);
  - `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `changeset:check`;
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:self-import` and `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`;
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps` and `check:unreferenced-sources`;
  - `check:esm-specifiers` (specifier leg), `check:sdui-registration-pins` and `check:element-data-source-declaration`;
  - `check:installed-pin-claims`.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) named three pending changesets that cite an edited file: `6896-…`, `7546-…` and `7694-…`. Each paragraph was read. Their claims (the `categories` coverage, the six series keys, the `normalizeSeries` limbs) are untouched. No pending changeset that mentions `specType` or the bar default is made false.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` ran over the 4 changed TS files, read as 4 entries: 0 errors.
  - `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` has 44 warnings and `normalizeChartSchema.ts` has 5, the same counts as at BASE.
  - The new pin has 2, both `no-explicit-any` in the `vi.mock('recharts')` block, the sibling pattern.
  - `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- Not run: `check:doc-types` / `check:doc-snippets`. No doc moved.
- Patch round 1 (head `514d71d1f`, seat REWORK `5964370972`, types only): `NormalizedChartSchema['chartType']` and `AdvancedChartImplProps.chartType` take `DeclaredChartFamily` = `NonNullable<ObjectChartSchema['chartType'] | ObjectChartSchema['specType']>`, read off `@object-ui/types` by reference (already a dependency; no cycle), instead of `string`. There is one named JSON-boundary cast in `normalizeChartSchema`, and the runtime unknown-type notice is unchanged. Negative compile probe: `{ chartType: 'bra' }` compiled at `a1e6721fa` and is TS2322 at the new head, while `'gauge'`, `'pivot'` and `'sankey'` compile. `plugin-charts` type-check, the console build (the `Bundle Analysis` program) and `vitest packages/plugin-charts/` (88 files, 1173 passed; matrix 130/130) are green. `main` moved only by a docs commit, so no merge.

## Acceptance notes

- **What an accepted document draws changes**, so the changeset is `@object-ui/plugin-charts` `minor`:
  - `specType` single-value families draw the number card;
  - `table` / `pivot` draw the tabular notice;
  - an off-spec `specType`, or no family at all, draws a notice instead of a bar.

  Every drawn family draws what it drew before, on both keys.
- **"Located" notice**, read as: rendered in the chart's place, naming the value (or saying none was named). There is no console-only signal.
- **The matrix's node shapes** differ from the card's. The card measured three `chartType` spellings, one `specType` spelling and a dimensionless dataset node. This pin puts the family on `specType` in all five shapes, and holds the `chartType` channel to the same answer per family. Its dataset node carries one dimension, so the same mark predicates apply.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` says the single-value and tabular families are refused on `chartType` and draw no chart on this node. That is still true, and nothing on the page, in the package README or in the skills states a bar default or a `specType` behaviour, so no doc moves.
- **Out of scope, reported for the seat to file (class a):** `ObjectChart`'s compare-to gate is `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo(schema.chartType)`, used for both the comparison fetch and the overlay. It reads `chartType` only.
  - A throwaway probe (never committed), through the real `SchemaRenderer`, rendered a `properties` bag with `compareTo: { kind: 'previousYear' }` and correctly keyed rows. Both documents parse on both faces.
  - With `chartType: 'scatter'`: 1 aggregate call, 2 scatter symbols.
  - With `specType: 'scatter'`: 2 calls, and the `scatter-multi-series` refusal ("A scatter plots one measure. Keep exactly one series: amount, amount__comparison").
  - `pie` on `specType` costs a wasted comparison fetch with the same picture.
  - Not fixed here: it is not on this card's surface, and its fix shape (where `ObjectChart` reads the resolved family) is not pinned.
- **Noted, not filed:**
  - `widgetDispatch.METRIC_LIKE_TYPES` (plugin-dashboard) and `SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES` (plugin-charts) name the same five families in two packages, with nothing tying them. Undrifted today. Carrier: none.
  - The console's dev-only preview sample dashboard has a `{ type: 'chart', title }` widget that names no family. Read from source, not rendered: it now shows the no-family notice where `AdvancedChartImpl` drew an empty bar frame.
- The `compareTo` gate in `ObjectChart` reads `chartType` only, so a family on `specType` gets the comparison fetch and overlay: `specType: scatter` renders the multi-series refusal, and `pie` wastes a fetch. Filed by the seat as objectui#11530, sequenced after this PR.
